name: qfd_res_slot_rt-t1-a102785a4
purpose: Slot tile for the qfd_sp_res_ser cluster (TP8 v4b slot 777.6 x 518.4), re-shaped from the cluster floorplan down: the closed rs view (259.2 x 172.8, chain pins W in / E out) cannot be composed (3 x 259.2 leaves no channel; abutted W/E stubs short or corner-touch in every orientation; ref_tile needs >= 20 um child channels). Same RTL and benches; outline 216 x 129.6 (macro + 20 um channels), BOTH chain faces on E (rd/rq in, od/rqf out: the pass-through never crosses the macro), i word on S, clk/strobes on N, W pin-free, so 8 tiles sit in a 3 x 3 grid with 21.6..36.7 um channels and every chain hop runs in the channel on the tile's E side.
